public.text: Conformance certification is suggested as a procurement condition, but the certifying authority, accreditation model, validity period, appeals process, and treatment of product updates are not defined.
public.suggestedRevision: Define certification governance or describe certification as an optional national mechanism. At minimum, require transparent test evidence, scope, version, issuer, date, limitations, and retesting triggers.
